profile_stats.sql: WITH all_time AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(commits), 0)::int AS commits, COALESCE(SUM(lines_added), 0)::int AS lines_added, COALESCE(SUM(lines_deleted), 0)::int AS lines_deleted, COALESCE(SUM(prs_opened), 0)::int AS prs_opened, COALESCE(SUM(prs_merged), 0)::int AS prs_merged, COALESCE(SUM(pr_reviews_total), 0)::int AS pr_reviews, COALESCE(SUM(issues_opened), 0)::int AS issues_opened, COALESCE(SUM(issues_closed), 0)::int AS issues_closed FROM daily_repository_activity), recent AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(commits), 0)::int AS commits, COALESCE(SUM(lines_added), 0)::int AS lines_added, COALESCE(SUM(lines_deleted), 0)::int AS lines_deleted, COALESCE(SUM(prs_opened), 0)::int AS prs_opened, COALESCE(SUM(prs_merged), 0)::int AS prs_merged, COALESCE(SUM(pr_reviews_total), 0)::int AS pr_reviews, COALESCE(SUM(issues_opened), 0)::int AS issues_opened, COALESCE(SUM(issues_closed), 0)::int AS issues_closed FROM daily_repository_activity WHERE activity_on >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '365 days') SELECT 'Commits' AS metric, all_time.commits AS all_time, recent.commits AS last_year FROM all_time, recent UNION ALL SELECT 'Lines added', all_time.lines_added, recent.lines_added FROM all_time, recent UNION ALL SELECT 'Lines deleted', all_time.lines_deleted, recent.lines_deleted FROM all_time, recent UNION ALL SELECT 'PRs opened', all_time.prs_opened, recent.prs_opened FROM all_time, recent UNION ALL SELECT 'PRs merged', all_time.prs_merged, recent.prs_merged FROM all_time, recent UNION ALL SELECT 'PR reviews', all_time.pr_reviews, recent.pr_reviews FROM all_time, recent UNION ALL SELECT 'Issues opened', all_time.issues_opened, recent.issues_opened FROM all_time, recent UNION ALL SELECT 'Issues closed', all_time.issues_closed, recent.issues_closed FROM all_time, recent

top_repositories.sql: SELECT r.full_name, r.web_url, COALESCE(SUM(d.commits), 0)::int AS commits, COALESCE(SUM(d.prs_opened), 0)::int AS pull_requests, COALESCE(SUM(d.pr_reviews_total), 0)::int AS reviews FROM daily_repository_activity d JOIN repositories r ON r.id = d.repository_id WHERE d.activity_on >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '365 days' AND r.visibility = 'public' AND r.redacted = false GROUP BY r.id, r.full_name, r.web_url ORDER BY commits DESC, pull_requests DESC, reviews DESC, full_name ASC LIMIT 10

languages.sql: SELECT r.primary_language AS language, COALESCE(SUM(d.commits), 0)::int AS commits FROM daily_repository_activity d JOIN repositories r ON r.id = d.repository_id WHERE d.activity_on >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '365 days' AND r.primary_language IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.primary_language ORDER BY commits DESC, language ASC LIMIT 10
